title: "Cyan" and "Light Blue" Color Name Fix
description: Changes the names of colors labeled "Cyan" and "Light Blue" to "Teal" and "Capri" respectively, when appropriate.
body:
Minecraft, by default, names many items that would be more accurately described as teal with "cyan", and items that would be more accurately described as capri with "light blue". (See gallery)

This resource pack changes the en_us language file to fix this.
